subject: Req4583 - Staff GRC offer structuring and band signoff
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Req4583 - Staff GRC offer structuring and band signoff

Team —

We have an outbound-ready offer packet for the Staff GRC Engineer candidate (Samantha Reed, referred via Redbridge). Attached is the proposed offer packet (req-4583-offer-packet.pdf) and the comp-band sheet. Summary of the proposed terms: 1) Base: $195,000; 2) Target equity: 0.40% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff); 3) Sign-on: $35,000 (split over first two payrolls); 4) Target start: 2025-11-03.

Context: This profile sits at the top of band 5 (Principal/Staff equivalence for GRC). Recruiting recommends this mix to be competitive into the insurance/regtech candidate pool. We are requesting band signoff and explicit sign-on authority (we have limited discretionary band for manager; sign-on > $25k requires director+ approval per policy).

Ask: Can I get a band signoff and approval for the $35k sign-on (or guidance on an acceptable counter structure) by EOD tomorrow so we can send the DocuSign link to the candidate? If you want an alternate mix (higher base + lower sign-on or retention RSUs), please call out specifics.

Attachments: req-4583-offer-packet.pdf (offer text + comps), comp-band-approval-sheet.xlsx (band reference).

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Req4583 - Staff GRC offer structuring and band signoff

Jasmine —

Thanks for the packet. High-level: I approve band 5 placement for this role. The comp math looks reasonable given the candidate's background and the competitive landscape you mentioned.

On sign-on: I will approve up to $30k in sign-on from my director authority. I prefer we keep base at $195k and reduce sign-on to $30k. If candidate pushes back and requests $35k, approve the $35k only if the total cash outlay in year 1 (base + sign-on) does not exceed $230k and if legal confirms CTC language.

Two other asks: 1) Please include a 6-month performance check clause with clear success metrics (GRC backlog closure, first 90-day audit milestones). 2) Ensure equity grant uses the current refresh policy (no separate retention RSU until after year one unless exceptional).

Vivek
VP, Security & GRC

Folks —

Thanks. HR side: I can sign the offer and initiate DocuSign once the final numbers are confirmed. A couple of operational notes so we don't get a last-minute exception request at approval time: 1) If we settle on $35k sign-on, I need an approved exception form routed (I can template it) that documents business rationale, manager sign-off, and planned repayment clause if the employee leaves within 12 months; 2) Please confirm which bonus plan (if any) this role is eligible for in year 1 — recruiting listed standard annual bonus eligibility, but that should be explicit in the offer.

Also, Mina, please confirm there are headcount funds in the fiscal 2026 GRC hiring plan for band 5 hires (this role should not be pushed from a planned HC bucket reserved for 2026 Q1).

Laura

Redwood Inference

Thanks for your patience. We finalized the internal approvals and have sent the DocuSign offer to Samantha at samantha.reed@redbridge.com. Final terms sent: Base $195,000; Sign-on $30,000 (approved by Vivek, with a documented discretionary exception in her file); Equity 0.40% over 4 years; Standard annual bonus eligibility; 6-month performance milestones included as an annex. The formal exception memo and repayment clause are saved in the HR packet.

Next steps: 1) Candidate to review and sign DocuSign (I will confirm once signed); 2) On sign, recruiting will run background check and confirm start date; 3) People Ops will route payroll setup.
